notes.title: [Eternal Stars in Love] Demo Now Live on STOVE! 🎮✨
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Eternal Stars in Love dev team! 💖

We’re excited to announce that the demo for Eternal Stars in Love is now live on STOVE! 🎉
This special 15+ version gives you a glimpse of the story and characters ahead of the full release.

👉 Play the DEMO here:
[url=https://store.onstove.com/ko/games/101789]STOVE STORE LINK[/url]

Crash-landed on a mysterious planet with no memories… 💫
In Eternal Stars in Love, you’ll team up with your beautiful and unforgettable crewmates as you search for fuel,
uncover hidden truths, and maybe even find romance among the stars!

✨ What awaits you?
- Gorgeous full-color artwork and special events with each heroine.
- Choices that shape your relationships—what will you say to win her heart?
- Branching storylines filled with mystery, danger, and unforgettable moments.

This demo is just a small preview—sweet and romantic, but much more awaits in the full release. 💕
If you’re looking forward to the uncut, truly steamy experience... trust us, the full version will not disappoint. 😉

Your feedback means the world to us, so please leave us some reviews after playing! We love reading your impressions. 💖

Thank you for all your love and support—it inspires us to keep going!

And for more updates and sneak peeks, don’t forget to follow us on Twitter (X)!
📲 [url=https://x.com/team_cherrycat]ETERNAL STARS IN LOVE OFFICIAL TWITTER (X)[/url]
